sources.title: Cuban Foreign Ministry: electronic tourist-visa application
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Cuba
sources.officialityEvidence: The live eVisa-Cuba service identifies the Cuban Foreign Ministry in its footer and is the Ministry's official online tourist-visa application.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Its nationality selector includes SSD — SOUTH SUDAN; the electronic visa is linked to the valid passport and its code is sent by email.

policies.title: South Sudan ordinary passports: Cuban electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Cuba's current Foreign Ministry electronic tourist-visa service directly accepts South Sudan nationality and issues the electronic visa before travel.
conditions: Use the Cuban Foreign Ministry electronic tourist-visa application with the South Sudan ordinary passport to be used for travel. The issued electronic visa is linked to that passport and the portal sends its code by email.
The portal directs sea travellers to a consular office. Work, residence, study, transit, special documents, carrier rules and final admission are outside this short-visitor policy.

application.label: Cuban Foreign Ministry electronic tourist-visa application
application.processingTime: The portal states that a response is sent within 72 business hours.
steps: Select South Sudan nationality and enter the valid ordinary passport details in the official electronic application.
Complete the specified procedure and receive the electronic-visa code by email before travel.
Travel with the passport to which the electronic visa is linked and comply with carrier and final-admission requirements.
